event_name: Red Bull Toro Rosso Honda Document 27 Date 08 April 2018 Time 18:47 2018 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 5 - 8 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 28 collided with car 11 in turn 4.
incident_time: Penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 2 points in total for the 12 month period)
offence: Involved in an incident as defined by Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards examined video evidence and the driver of car 28 braked late for turn 4 causing the collision with car 11. The Stewards determined that the driver of car 28 was wholly to blame for the collision. Gerd Ennser Paolo Longoni Danny Sullivan Mazen Al Hilli
rules_referenced: Article 38.1 of the FIA Formula One Sporting
title: 2018 Bahrain Grand Prix 2018 Offence Car 28 Causing A Collision With Car 11 In T4 Doc 27
